details:
Q1: Which area of the repository should change?
Choices:
A) The clarify / plan / implement issue pipeline workflows
B) The review / autofix workflows (reviewers, editor, conflict resolver)
C) The orchestrator (decomposition, poller, judges, security pass)
D) Documentation only (README, docs/, agents.d fragments)
E) Something else: please name the file(s), workflow or feature (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What problem should the change fix?
Choices:
A) A bug or failing behaviour: please link the run, PR or issue (RECOMMENDED)
B) Performance or cost (runtime, API calls, model tokens)
C) Reliability (stalls, retries, flaky recovery)
D) Readability or maintainability only, with no change in behaviour
Q3: How will we know it is done?
Choices:
A) A specific observable behaviour or test result, which you state in your answer (RECOMMENDED)
B) A specific metric reaching a target value, which you state in your answer
C) No criterion yet: close this issue and open a new one once the target and problem are defined
